verdict.rationale: Viam's CLI reference documents deleting cloud data and tagging data that matches a filter, which gives a scriptable, agent-friendly deletion path alongside SQL/MQL queries to find the data. Nothing in the pack shows configurable retention policies, such as automatic expiry or time-based deletion of captured data. Missing for 10: configurable data retention policies/auto-expiry, detailed docs on deletion semantics (filters, permanence, scope), independent or hands-on corroboration.
